You can watch them in their small kitchen as they prepare manti with local cheese and top it with tomato sauce, or shaping meatballs and cooking them in a rich tomato jus. The menu is concise, and it's wise to arrive early to avoid disappointment, but the reward is a heartwarming experience that offers an authentic taste of Cappadocia.

rows.name: Hodan Yalıkavak
rows.address: Kudur Mevkii Sehit Engin Buyuksoylemez Caddesi No:9, Bodrum, 48890, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Çiğdem Seferoğlu invites you to the Avantgarde Refined Yalikavak Hotel, home to her open-air restaurant that boasts a magnificent view of the sea. More compelling still is her personal take on the region's culinary bounty. Her light and elegant cuisine highlights fish and seafood with a feminine touch. She confits gurnard in olive oil, which renders the texture wonderfully soft, and serves the fish with fennel seasoned with turmeric and coriander seeds, a blend of purslane and mint leaves with nectarine, and warm Turkish bread. The chef also prepares meticulous vegetarian dishes and proves that healthy food can indeed be profoundly flavoursome.

rows.name: Yakamengen III
rows.address: Yaka Mahallesi, Yaka Küme Evleri No:70, Datça, 48900, Türkiye
rows.description_en: This charming restaurant is housed in a converted olive oil mill on the Reşadiye peninsula. The building has been beautifully restored without compromising its authenticity, and boasts a lovely garden where you can dine beneath the olive trees. Duru Akgül's cuisine is contemporary and draws on the best the region has to offer. She tends her own kitchen garden and enjoys working with lesser-known seafood such as blue swimmer crab. She binds the crab meat with a yoghurt cream, for example, and serves it with a mixed vegetable brunoise and crisp courgette fritters topped with local herbs. Her dishes are always beautifully presented and packed with bold flavours. Do take time to peruse the interesting selection of local wines.

rows.name: Lokanta 1741
rows.address: Alemdar Mahallesi, Profesör Kazım İsmail Gürkan Caddesi No:34, Cağaloğlu Hamamı, Fatih, Istanbul, 34110, Türkiye
rows.description_en: This beautiful contemporary restaurant with a romantic roof terrace is right next to Cağaloğlu Hamam. It serves Turkish culinary classics, some dating back to 1741, with a modern twist. The chef sometimes introduces surprising textures and flavours but never loses sight of tradition. In the evening, they serve only a more sophisticated fine dining menu. Here, you can savour a zesty sea bass ceviche, as well as lamb brochettes with distinct barbecue notes and a punchy aubergine caviar. Oenophiles should definitely take the opportunity to explore the wine cellar.

rows.name: Eleos Yeşilköy
rows.address: Yeşilköy mahallesi, Yeşilbahçe Sokak No:9, Bakırköy, Istanbul, 34149, Türkiye
rows.description_en: This exciting restaurant, reminiscent of a Greek tavern and complete with a lovely terrace, lies just a couple of streets from the marina in Yeşilköy, a residential area on the outskirts of Istanbul with the feel of a seaside resort. The wonderful seafood on display also takes centre stage on the menu, which includes a variety of mezze brimming with Mediterranean zest and beautifully crispy-fried red mullet with skin-on potatoes and a fresh salad. Expect a relaxed dining experience – unpretentious and focused on honest flavours.

rows.name: Calipso Fish
rows.address: Küçükyalı Sahil, Cumhuriyet Caddesi No:2, Küçükyalı/Maltepe, Istanbul, 34840, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Istanbul residents come to this sun-drenched restaurant to escape the hustle and bustle of the city. The waiters give expert advice on the wide selection of mezze in the display fridge – the salads are beautifully fragrant! And that's just the beginning, because the traditional preparation methods accentuate the rich flavours of super-fresh fish and seafood. Whatever you choose, the chef will cook it according to your wishes: the bluefish, for example, can be barbecued whole and served with al dente vegetables. This is ingredient-led cuisine that never fails to impress.

rows.name: Orfoz
rows.address: Kumbahçe Mahallesi, Zeki Müren Caddesi No:13/1, Bodrum, 48400, Türkiye
rows.description_en: The beautiful bay this restaurant overlooks is the pride of the Bozçağa brothers – not only for the azure waters, but also the bountiful fish and seafood they have to offer. Their family-run restaurant specialises in seafood and plant-forward cuisine. A commitment to locally sourced ingredients and short supply chains ensures exceptional quality. The chefs' love for the sea is palpable in every dish, from sea snails cooked in a court bouillon and finished with a herb cream accented with a pronounced hint of garlic, to eel that is confit and lightly smoked, resulting in a buttery texture. It is worth perusing the wine list, as it is clearly a passion of the owners and even includes some of their own labels.

rows.name: Seraf Vadi
rows.address: Ayazağa, Kemerburgaz Caddesi No:7G, İç Kapı No:7, Sarıyer, Istanbul, 34396, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Start your meal with the wood-fire grilled onion stuffed with rice, spices and currants – a speciality of the house. And be sure to sample the other mezze, such as the piping-hot lahmacum topped with succulent lamb, mint, parsley and a judicious squeeze of lemon. The main courses featuring various cuts of lamb are to die for. This contemporary restaurant close to Vadistanbul Shopping Mall and Galatasaray's football stadium is a celebration of Anatolian culinary heritage.

rows.name: Muutto Anatolian Tapas Bar
rows.address: Kılıçali Paşa, Meclis-i Mebusan Caddesi No:8, Beyoğlu, Istanbul, 34433, Türkiye
rows.description_en: To soak up Galataport's trendy atmosphere, a spot on the front terrace overlooking the passing boats is the place to be. But whether you sip your cocktail alfresco or inside the modern bistro, you're in for an exceptional evening. The restaurant specialises in Spanish tapas reimagined through a Turkish culinary lens. You might start with prawns accompanied by a spicy cherry cream, move on to a shared plate of patatas bravas and grilled squid, and choose a more traditional main dish such as a pide or baked sea bass. The chefs have a flair for reinvention and have curated an enticing menu. Eating at Muutto makes for a great night out!

rows.name: Malva
rows.address: Torba, Kaynar Caddesi No:15, Bodrum, 48400, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Housed in luxury hotel Susona, this restaurant feels both elegant and hip. But the most stunning feature of all is the breathtaking view of the coastline. The chef and his team will be happy to tell you about their commitment to sustainability, including a zero-waste approach and close collaboration with their suppliers. Their creative cuisine draws on traditional and modern influences, celebrating the authentic flavours of the ingredients. For instance, the courgette flowers stuffed with rice and chopped mussels are seasoned with a classic blend of herbs and a judicious twist of lemon. The charcoal-grilled mussels add delightful smoky nuances. A compelling dining experience guaranteed!

rows.name: Amavi
rows.address: Alaçatı Mahallesi, 13003. Sokak No:1, Çeşme, Izmir, 35937, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Alaçati is a picturesque town with a lot to offer, but Amavi is the place to be for foodies. Walk through the cocktail bar, where DJs play in the evening, and take a seat in the trendy restaurant, which exudes its own unique elegance. Seafood takes pride of place here – there's even a fish aging cabinet visible in the open kitchen. Each dish is creative, vibrant and bears the chef's signature. A compelling dining experience defined by playful textures and intense, layered flavours.

rows.name: Ritüel
rows.address: Şifne Mahallesi 5495. Sokak No:26, Çeşme, Izmir, 35000, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Head to GAIA BY THE SEA hotel, follow the path to the rear and immerse yourself in the romantic atmosphere of this outdoor restaurant. The view of the water is utterly captivating! You even make this a regular treat: Chef Tolga Kamiloğlu brings his experience to bear in a contemporary take on Turkish cuisine, which is detailed and elevated with the occasional Asian influence. Highlights include the charcoal-grilled baby calamari with cherry tomatoes in a jus of tomato, vinegar and mirin, and the orange-themed dessert with lime sorbet, yuzu sorbet and yuzu jelly – each plate delivers an experience. The wonderful à la carte selection is guaranteed to delight.

rows.name: Reserved Restaurant
rows.address: Adnan Menderes Caddesi, Uçhisar, Nevşehir, 50000, Türkiye
rows.description_en: This country house possesses a certain rustic elegance, with its characteristic stone architecture, wood features and numerous period details. The lounge atmosphere is also incredibly inviting. After a refreshing cocktail or a local wine, savour traditional dishes brimming with character, presented in a contemporary style. Mezze include crispy courgette strips fried in batter with a yogurt and dill dip, and manti filled with meat, served with creamy yogurt and spicy oil – a true taste of the sun on your plate. In the evenings, a DJ provides a lively musical backdrop for no extra charge.

rows.name: Mori
rows.address: Fevzi Çakmak Caddesi No:24, Fethiye, 48300, Türkiye
rows.description_en: With the azure sea against the backdrop of the majestic mountains in the distance and the palatial yachts in the marina just a few metres from your table, the terrace here is the place to be. Located at Yacht Classic Hotel, this restaurant specialised in Italian cuisine eschews unnecessary frills and focuses on flavour. Think al dente linguine with a light velouté sauce and ultra-fresh seafood such as tender squid and pink prawns. The extensive menu will not disappoint!

rows.name: Barbarossa
rows.address: Adnan Menderes Caddesi No:89, Asarlik Mevkii PK 225, Bodrum, 48400, Türkiye
rows.description_en: The luxurious Caresse resort's Mediterranean restaurant offers a delightfully laid-back dining experience. Watch the chefs at work in the outdoor kitchen while cocktails are shaken in the bar and chill-out music fills the air. The view of the sea and the moored yachts never gets old! Seafood takes centre stage here, cooked up in traditional Greek and Italian ways. Wonderfully crispy deep-fried squid with a fresh tartar sauce, barbecued sea bass with perfectly seasoned vegetables: the best of Mediterranean cuisine served up without any fuss. Reserve a poolside spot ahead of time and enjoy a refreshing swim after dinner.

rows.name: Seraf Mahmutbey
rows.address: Mahmutbey Mahallesi, Peyami Safa Caddesi No:38/D, Bağcılar, Istanbul, 34200, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Sinem Özler sets great store by goods from local producers. You can taste and see this for yourself, because they are also for sale in the shop of this spacious, modern restaurant, just outside the city centre. For example, she works with Trakya Kivircik lamb in a bid to keep traditional recipes alive. The İçli Köfte with the same lamb is an absolute must. To bring those ancient Anatolian flavours to the table, this chef likes to use a wood-fired oven, and she never loses sight of the changing seasons and her surroundings.

rows.name: 1924 İstanbul
rows.address: Istiklal Caddesi, Olivya Geçidi No:7, Beyoğlu, Istanbul, 34435, Türkiye
rows.description_en: This restaurant was opened in a previous incarnation by Russian refugees in 1924. Today diners can relive those glory days in a beautifully restored and opulent setting that exudes historical grandeur and features eye-catching panelling and mirrors. Live piano and accordion music makes for a buzzing atmosphere. The chefs put a modern spin on Russian specialities, including stuffed pirozhki, delicate smoked salmon with warm blini, and beef Stroganoff. Generous portions, juicy meat and amazing flavour. And to drink? A glass of vodka from their impressive selection, of course!

rows.name: Deraliye
rows.address: Divanyolu Caddesi, Alemdar Mahallesi, Ticarethane Sokak No:10, Sultan Ahmet, Fatih, Istanbul, 34110, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Deraliye is a landmark of the historical Sultanahmet neighbourhood, where there is one tourist restaurant next to the other. The colourful, opulent decor immediately catches the eye and, like the cuisine, is a tribute to the Ottoman Empire. The extensive menu features an array of dishes devised for sharing and specialities such as mezze, barbecued offerings and kebabs. Tempting options include duck stew in filo pastry with fragrant spiced rice, or a lamb and tomato dish, slowly simmered in an earthenware pot to let the flavours meld. Here, you can savour sumptuous Ottoman cuisine, occasionally presented with a touch of showmanship. Good to know: Deraliye also organises cookery classes.

rows.name: Levan
rows.address: Kuşçular, Kuşçular Caddesi No:3, Urla, Izmir, 35430, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Dining with a view of the vineyards, or on the terrace surrounded by the grapevines, is an experience that will leave a lasting impression. Levan offers a convivial atmosphere in a charming and intimate setting. On the chalkboard, you will find a dozen dishes, from mezze to share to main courses to savour on your own. The traditional cuisine of the Aegean coast is given a contemporary twist: Examples include sea bass marinated in lemon before cooking and served with a crisp salad, or house-made ravioli stuffed with various cheeses and accompanied by a Parmesan and cream sauce. Get ready for a Mediterranean feast!

rows.name: OCAK
rows.address: Hobyar Mahallesi, Mimar Vedat Sokak No:5, Fatih, Istanbul, 34112, Türkiye
rows.description_en: OCAK has breathed new life into this former tobacco warehouse in the Old City, turning it into an intimate restaurant with exposed brick walls, soft lighting and marble finishings. The chef proposes only a single set menu that showcases his unique take on Turkish cuisine. He elevates chickpeas to new heights in a variety of dishes, including an amazing crispy deep-fried creation. He consistently strikes a perfect balance between tradition and modernity. Your curiosity will be piqued by every dish.

rows.name: Birinci Kordon Balık Restoran
rows.address: Alsancak, Atatürk Caddesi No:196/A, Konak, Izmir, 35220, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Fish, fish and more fish – that's what you can expect at this rather simple restaurant. The refrigerated display counter immediately catches the eye as the charcoal grill works overtime in the kitchen. After some freshly prepared mezze, for example, allow the chef to delight you with succulent barbecued calamari rings in a chilli crust, or just as expertly flame-grilled sea bass. Such incredible flavours! No frills here: the focus lies squarely on unadulterated top-quality produce. A gem among the many restaurants on the quayside.

rows.name: Moniq Restaurant
rows.address: Aşağı, Gedik Sokak No:8, Uçhisar, Nevşehir, 50280, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Nestled in one of the stylishly transformed caves that together form the remarkable Taskonaklar hotel, Moniq Restaurant showcases the rugged stone beauty of Cappadocia. The opportunity to take an aperitif on one of the terraces overlooking the stunning Pigeon Valley is not to be missed. Inside, the ambiance is charming and inviting. Chef Mustafa Türkten works with local women from nearby villages to create a menu built on traditional recipes and regional ingredients, with a few modern touches thrown in. Highlights include manti with roasted aubergine or hearty lamb casserole with stewed peppers and tomatoes, finished with a spiced lamb jus and served with pita bread. If you visit on Friday or Saturday, be sure to try the Ottoman mutancana.

rows.name: Basta Neo Bistro
rows.address: Caddebostan, Operatör Cemil Topuzlu Caddesi No:39, Kadıköy, Istanbul, 34728, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Kaan Sakarya and Derin Aribaş honed their skills in top-flight European restaurants before opening this lively bistro. A seat at the counter offers the best view of how they blend European and Turkish traditions with a street-food twist. Their seasonal, market-fresh cuisine is beautifully showcased in the sweet brioche filled with tomato jam, onion and stracciatella. The pan con tomate with perfectly salted anchovies is simply irresistible. The appealing menu demonstrates the chefs' knack for infusing every dish with personality.

rows.name: Apartıman Yeniköy
rows.address: Yeniköy, Köybaşı Caddesi No:153, Sarıyer, Istanbul, 34464, Türkiye
rows.description_en: A mostly youthful and hip crowd frequents this pleasant bistro, which matches the energy of its neighbourhood. Lounge music plays in the background, the impressive drinks list features a notable selection of orange wines. The kitchen is run by a female chef who has composed an extensive and enticing menu that combines Mediterranean verve with Middle Eastern spiciness. For instance, she barbecues lamb to medium-rare and serves it with orzo cooked in a kokoreç broth and greengage. Tip: For a truly filling meal, consider ordering an additional starter.

rows.name: ÇARK balık Çeşme
rows.address: 16 Eylül, 3047. Sokak No:7/A, Çeşme, Izmir, 35930, Türkiye
rows.description_en: This family-run Turkish osteria is tucked away in one of Çeşme's charming side streets, making it the perfect stop after a day of shopping or relaxing on the beach. Super-fresh fish and seafood is served straight off the boat at lunchtime, in simple dishes that showcase the natural flavours of the produce in all their glory. Start with mezze such as artichoke hearts with spring onions and crushed raspberries, then move on to prawns grilled to that perfect point of translucency, with an exquisite jus just begging to be mopped up with every last piece of bread – no unnecessary frills, just the briny richness of coastal cuisine with Mediterranean flair.

rows.name: Rumelihisarı İskele
rows.address: Yahya Kemal Caddesi No:1, Rumeli Hisarı/Sarıyer, Istanbul, 34470, Türkiye
rows.description_en: At this classic waterfront pavilion, every table enjoys panoramic views of the mighty Bosporus, with its endless stream of boats – a breathtaking setting in which to savour the finest seafood. Having sampled the aromatic mezze presented at your table, you pick your fish from the abundant selection and indicate if you would like it steamed, barbecued or deep-fried. The kitchen puts the emphasis squarely on flavour, without any unnecessary flourishes. The Iskele special, a seafood pan with octopus, prawns and more, is seasoned only with paprika and chilli.

rows.name: Sunset Grill & Bar
rows.address: Kuruçeşme Mahallesi, Yol Sokak No:2, Ulus/Beşiktaş, Istanbul, 34345, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Sunset Grill & Bar could be in a Hollywood film. This spacious, upscale restaurant is located in the heights of Ulus Park, providing a magnificent view of the city and the Bosporus – be sure to ask for a table by the window. The well-heeled clientele is drawn by the attentive service, and the extensive menu, which features classic French cuisine, Asian-inspired dishes and trendy sushi options, as well as the impressive wine list. Treat yourself to one of the barbecue specialities – think butter-soft beef fillet with a brown sauce enhanced with yuzu and mustard. An exhilarating dining experience!

rows.name: Tuğra Restaurant
rows.address: Çırağan Caddesi No:32, Beşiktaş, Istanbul, 34349, Türkiye
rows.description_en: At Tuğra, diners are made to feel like royalty. Marble columns frame a view of the glimmering Bosphorus. Here, you can bask in the historical splendour of the magnificent Çırağan Palace – the opulence never fails to impress. And the terrace is simply breathtaking! The impeccable service leaves you wanting for nothing. As for the food, Ottoman culinary heritage goes hand in hand with haute cuisine, with traditional flavours elevated by the chef's expert touch and elegant plating. For instance, tender beef fillet is paired with a robust brown jus and clever accompaniments such as a quenelle of fermented milk, mashed potatoes with pine nuts and an exquisite onion confit – a fascinating combination.

rows.name: Mürver
rows.address: Novotel İstanbul Bosphorus, Kemankeş Caddesi No:57-59, Karaköy/Beyoğlu, Istanbul, 34425, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Take the lift to the top floor of the Novotel Istanbul Bosphorus and discover the world of Mürver. You can start with an aperitif in the hip cocktail bar, then soak up the romantic atmosphere of the restaurant. Finally, take in the breathtaking views of the metropolis from the fabulous terrace. An open fire is the centrepiece of the kitchen, where you can also see meat and fish drying. Smoky and barbecue notes form the basis of captivating creations featuring regional produce and original combinations. The dishes are spicy, bold and fiery. Think grilled squid rings with green beans and a subtly spicy muhammara sauce, or 28-day aged ribeye. This buzzing establishment is the place to be!

rows.name: Beyti
rows.address: Şenlikköy Mahallesi, Orman Sokak No:6, Florya/Bakırköy, Istanbul, 34153, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Beyti Güler is a living legend in Istanbul. Since the 1980s, Istanbulites have been coming to dine in this stylish building, a fine example of nostalgic Turkish charm, with its little fountains at the entrance and sculptures in the garden. And this historical establishment boasts no fewer than 12 dining rooms! The charcoal grill is at the centre of the kitchen, where the experienced chefs cook all kinds of meat to perfection. Take the imam bayildi, for example: meltingly tender braised aubergine topped with tomatoes, bell peppers and onions, cooked just long enough to bring out all their flavours. And be sure to try one of the kebabs, too. Traditional Turkish fare just as it should be.

rows.name: Borsa Restaurant
rows.address: Vaniköy Caddesi No:12, Adile Sultan Sarayı, Üsküdar, Istanbul, 34684, Türkiye
rows.description_en: The Adile Sultan Palace is an events venue that is as spectacular as its name suggests. A stroll through the building will give you a sense of its grandeur and splendour – characteristics that Borsa is fortunate to share. To dine against a breathtaking backdrop of the Bosporus, head to the terrace. This upmarket restaurant showcases traditional Turkish cuisine on an à la carte basis. In his dish featuring medium-rare lamb ribs, spinach and roast potatoes, the chef allows the distinctive flavours of the ingredients to shine through. Less is more at Borsa. Make sure you leave room for dessert – the classic katmer (crispy filo pastry filled with pistachio) is very tempting!

rows.name: Aila
rows.address: Büyükdere Caddesi No:76/B, Mecidiyeköy/Şişli, Istanbul, 34394, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Aila exudes luxury and grandeur. Smooth marble, high ceilings, dark wood: the decor is a feast for the eyes. Turkey's rich culinary heritage is given a contemporary twist with meticulously prepared premium ingredients. They put the focus on spices – they even have a spice library – and the provenance of the ingredients, which is detailed on a small informative card on your table. For example, the chef grills grouper over an open fire and serves it with beurre blanc infused with orange and sumac for a unique balance of rich, zesty and bitter nuances. Be sure to indulge in a glass of raki (they have an outstanding selection!) to complement this modern homage to culinary tradition.

rows.name: Akira Back İstanbul
rows.address: Ataköy 2-5-6. Kısım Mahallesi, Rauf Orbay Caddesi No:2/1 LB, Bakırköy, Istanbul, 34158, Türkiye
rows.description_en: The view of the Sea of Marmara is the highlight of this modern and inviting restaurant located in the JW Marriott hotel. Be sure to go for a spot on the terrace! Akira Back has restaurants all over the world and has appointed one of his right-hand men as head chef in Istanbul. The dishes embody a distinctive fusion of predominantly Japanese and other Asian cuisines. Fine sushi, tasty gyoza, beef tataki that melts in the mouth, perfectly robata-grilled prawns… You will definitely want to come back for this contemporary whirlwind of Eastern flavours.

rows.name: Sia Eli
rows.address: Gümüşlük Mahallesi, 1120. Sokak No:108, Gümüşlük, Bodrum, 48970, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Surrounded by gardens dotted with olive trees, with the sea, which supplies the day's catch, just a stone's throw away, and the rolling hills providing a lush backdrop, Sia Eli is the perfect setting for a romantic dinner for two. This open-air restaurant also has a trendy edge, with cool lounge music setting the mood. The kitchen keeps pace with a menu of contemporary international dishes ranging from ceviche to an original take on mezze. This is one of those laid-back places where you can savour crispy red mullet tempura accompanied by a fragrant herbaceous salad, sip a refreshing cocktail and appreciate just how wonderful life can be.

rows.name: SOTA ALAÇATI
rows.address: Alaçatı Mahallesi, 11039. Sokak No:18, Çeşme, Izmir, 35937, Türkiye
rows.description_en: The lobster and oyster tanks give away the fact that this open-air restaurant's main supplier is the sea. SOTA's Mediterranean soul is evident in everything from its mosaic tiles to the fresh seafood on the menu. The squid has the perfect firm texture and is seasoned to have just the right amount of zing. The seafood is super fresh and wonderful in combination with al dente tagliatelle. This restaurant is dedicated to showcasing the sea's rich bounty.

rows.name: Orkide Balık
rows.address: Göltürkbükü Mahallesi, Sahil Sokak No:34, Bodrum, 48483, Türkiye
rows.description_en: At Orkide Balik, you can almost feel the sand between your toes as you enjoy your meal, and, on warm days, the terrace beneath the tall trees is especially inviting. The chef takes full advantage of the restaurant's seaside location to serve fish at its absolute freshest. But before you order your main course, be sure to sample starters such as "seacuterie" (seafood charcuterie) and stuffed mussels, and don't miss out on the mezze displayed in the refrigerated counter. The dishes are prepared without any fuss, and with that traditional sense of generosity. Think marinated squid or deep-fried sea bass with aubergine and a bechamel sauce seasoned with mustard. It is always a good idea to round off your meal with the exceptional soğuk baklava. Sometimes the best things in life are the simplest.

rows.name: İsabey Bağevi
rows.address: Gölcükler Mahallesi, 901. Sokak İstasyon Mevkii No:38, Menderes, Izmir, 35470, Türkiye
rows.description_en: The Isabey wine estate grows mostly Sauvignon Blanc, but you will find more than impressive rows of vines on its land. Indeed, there is a magnificent terrace on which to dine in the shade of a majestic plane tree that is over 350 years old. This restaurant is committed to serving food and wine of the highest quality. The buttery lamb stock with medium-rare lamb chops and the squid stuffed with minced lamb and accompanied by a fine white wine sauce are testament to the depth and flavour of this classic cuisine.

rows.name: AŞEKA
rows.address: Müeyyedzade Mahallesi, Arap Oğlan Sokak No:6, Beyoğlu, Istanbul, 34425, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Tucked away in a side street in the Karaköy neighbourhood, this somewhat inconspicuous historical building reveals a tastefully decorated interior featuring intimate lighting, a palette of dark brown hues, and regularly changing artwork. Diners can choose from a tempting à la carte selection or opt for one of the creative set menus. The dishes are not unnecessarily complicated but are bursting with flavour – it is the seasoning and robust sauces that set them apart. Take, for instance, the succulent agnolotti del plin, filled with slow-cooked oxtail and served with a Parmesan cream and fine breadcrumbs. Be sure to stop by the handsome bar to sample one of the cocktails.

rows.name: Zuma İstanbul
rows.address: İstinye Park No:461, Sarıyer, Istanbul, 34460, Türkiye
rows.description_en: The Istanbul branch of this chic Japanese restaurant is on a par with its London, Dubai and other outposts. That means top-notch ingredients that are showcased by a contemporary approach to authentic Japanese cuisine. On the menu: sushi (you can watch the chef meticulously preparing it at the counter), tempura, fish from the robata grill, vegetarian options… There's so much to choose from! Replete with subtle East Asian nuances, the ingredient-led, intensely flavoursome dishes never fail to hit the mark. The gyoza, filled with minced beef and lamb and seasoned with paprika, chilli, sesame and lemongrass, are simply irresistible. Rest assured: The cosmopolitan Zuma feels right at home amid the most exclusive fashion boutiques of Istinye Park shopping centre.

rows.name: Esca
rows.address: İstinye Park AVM, Bahçelerarası Mahallesi Şehit Bnb. Ali Resmi Tufan Caddesi No:3, Bağımsız Bölüm No:Z95, Balçova, Izmir, 35330, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Located at one of the entrances to the glamorous Istinye Park shopping centre, Esca has a contemporary yet cosy feel – perfect for an intimate dinner for two! The lovely terrace beckons in fine weather. Osman Sezener expresses his passion for Mediterranean cuisine and local produce through an international menu. With options ranging from sushi and gyoza to house-made pasta and succulent lamb chops with a pistachio sauce, every palate is catered for. The tiramisu, with its beautiful balance between the bitterness of the coffee and the creaminess of the mascarpone, has already become a house favourite. Treat yourself to one of the signature cocktails.

rows.name: Gorgoli
rows.address: Yılmaz Sokak No:10, Mustafapaşa, Ürgüp, 50400, Türkiye
rows.description_en: This simply appointed restaurant is nestled in the charming university town of Mustafapaşa. The Gorgoli Valley is just nearby, and for the chef it's a privileged source of all manner of produce. The extensive menu reflects his deep respect for his terroir and local culinary tradition. Aubergine and peppers are grilled just right for a rich smoky-sweet starter; lamb is slow-cooked to succulent perfection and served with a creamy wheat risotto. Nothing is overworked – every dish is a celebration of true flavour.

rows.name: Saklı Konak Cappadocia
rows.address: Tekelli Mahallesi, 2. Karlık Sokak No:3, Uçhisar, Nevşehir, 50000, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Located just outside Nevşehir's tourist hub, this convivial and inviting restaurant is the perfect place to take a break and delve into the region's cuisine. They take pride here in their testi kebabs and unique versions of kofta, but be sure to sample the manti, too – made with grilled aubergine, butter and tomato sauce, and topped with a yoghurt dressing and a sprinkling of dried herbs, they are simply divine! The combination of local produce and traditional recipes ensures that each dish is a joy. Consider extending your experience with a stay in one of the guestrooms.

rows.name: Kasap Fuat Çeşme
rows.address: Altınyunus, 3435. Sokak No:66, Çeşme, Izmir, 35930, Türkiye
rows.description_en: The moment meat lovers walk into this cosy establishment with its delightful terrace at the back, their spirits are lifted. An array of cuts, expertly prepared by the butcher, awaits in the refrigerated display counter, and in the background, you can see the barbecue where the magic happens. Options include marinated ribeye, perfectly rare and with a crispy fat cap, as well as succulent burgers in house-made buns. What you see is what you get, and it's absolutely delicious!

rows.name: ONNO Grill & Bar
rows.address: Göcek Adası, Göcek, Fethiye, 48310, Türkiye
rows.description_en: A free boat ride takes you from Göcek Marina to the island where ONNO Grill & Bar is located in just 10min – during which time you can fully unwind and take in the beautiful surroundings. At this open-air restaurant, you dine right by the water's edge, which certainly adds to the charm of the venue. The cuisine is very much in keeping with the times, Mediterranean in spirit and centred on delicious seafood. The chef also likes to age certain fish for extra depth. His command of cooking techniques is impeccable, as exemplified by an octopus dish with crisp skin and exceptionally tender flesh, served with a sauce in which tomato, pepper, bacon, onion and candied lemon zest create a rich, Mediterranean-style blend of flavours. An experience to be savoured.

rows.name: Havuş Lokantası
rows.address: Ataköy 2-5-6, Rauf Orbay Caddesi Kapı No-4 İç Kapı No-7, Yalı Ataköy, Bakırköy, Istanbul, 34158, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Leave the bustle of central Istanbul behind and head to Ataköy, where celebrated chef Ömür Akkor – television personality and prolific cookbook author – welcomes you to his latest project. On your way to the modern dining space, you pass a delicatessen brimming with all manner of tempting treats. The à la carte selection features traditional fare, spotlighting specialities from Kilis, the chef's hometown. The rice with sautéed pistachios, served alongside a succulent leg of lamb is a good example. This is not overcomplicated cuisine, just straightforward dishes packed with flavour. The set menu is guaranteed to have you smitten.

rows.name: Kornél
rows.address: Bitez, Adliye Caddesi No:34/A, Bodrum, 48470, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Terracotta and sandy hues perfectly complement Kornél's cosy ambiance, and the terrace to the rear has that appealing Ibiza feel. The bar serves up incredible cocktails that change with the seasons, while in the kitchen, the charcoal oven works overtime baking delicious pizzettas and more. The extensive menu includes a beautiful zesty sea bass ceviche, hearty pasta dishes and a vegetarian creation featuring beetroot and dukkah. Kornél offers a relaxed dining experience with great food all year round.

rows.name: Roka Bahçe
rows.address: Hacımemiş Mahallesi, 2027. Sokak No:6, Çeşme, Izmir, 35937, Türkiye
rows.description_en: The narrow, stone-paved streets of Alacati are always buzzing with activity. Tucked away in one such lane is this alfresco restaurant, whose lively atmosphere instantly draws you in. Gökhan Safkan allows Turkish flavours to seamlessly merge with Bosnian influences, creating a heady mix in dishes such as artichokes cooked with onion and garlic in an orange-infused broth, or succulent pljeskavica (Balkan meat patties) and delicately grilled, ultra-fresh sea bass. This laid-back place puts the emphasis on fun, and the steady stream of dishes emerging from the kitchen is testament to this. You have been warned: the charm of Roka Bahçe is irresistible.

rows.name: telezzüz
rows.address: Kuzguncuk, Koç Topluluğu Spor Kulübü, Kuşbakışı Caddesi No:16, Üsküdar, Istanbul, 34674, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Even before you walk into this colourful establishment, the ornate exterior hints that nature is celebrated at Telezzüz. The location, in a sports complex, is also rather unique. The restaurant clearly prioritises sustainable practices such as local sourcing, a zero-waste approach and plant-forward cooking. The chefs are creative in crafting delicious vegan dishes. Think mushroom ceviche, or deep-fried artichoke with a rich mushroom ketchup, a sweet plum and chilli sauce, olive oil mayonnaise and crunchy vegetables. And what better than a refreshing cocktail to accompany such deliciously natural food?

rows.name: Gula Urla
rows.address: Kuşçular Mahallesi, Kuşçular Caddesi No:46, Urla, Izmir, 35430, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Whether you're soaking up the sun on the verdant terrace or cosying up by the fireplace, Gula Urla is inviting all year round. The fresh fish on display makes it clear that the sea is the restaurant's main supplier; vegetables and cheese are also sourced locally. After a delicious cocktail or glass of local wine, tuck into shrimp salad with mango and avocado, or perhaps a tandoori-style squid dish, before finishing off with a creamy katmer with red berries. The extensive menu is a seafood lover's dream come true (plus, there is a separate set menu featuring meat from the wood-fire oven).

rows.name: Spago Istanbul by Wolfgang Puck
rows.address: Mim Kemal Öke Caddesi No:35, Nişantaşı/Şişli, Istanbul, 34367, Türkiye
rows.description_en: The rooftop of the upscale St Regis Hotel is the place to soak up those hip Istanbul vibes. Sip a delicious cocktail on the terrace that affords sublime views of the city (such romantic sunsets!), sit at the long bar, or simply enjoy the lounge music and modern luxury that surrounds you. The kitchen is overseen by Wolfgang Puck, who creates a unique blend of Italian, Californian and Asian influences. Expect sophisticated flavours and techniques, home cooking and international panache. Be sure to try the smoked salmon pizza, as well as the duck spring rolls with their spicy hoisin sauce and sweet plum sauce. There are also some very appealing modern sushi options for sharing. For the perfect accompaniment, select a bottle from the fabulous wine list, which includes some Turkish labels.

rows.name: Lokanta Feriye
rows.address: Yıldız Mahallesi Çırağan Caddesi No:44, Beşiktaş, Istanbul, 34347, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Dining in the gardens of the fully refurbished Feriye Palace is a new experience each time. Here on the edge of the Bosphorus – some diners even arrive by boat – you have the ever-evolving backdrop of the constant coming and going of the ships. And there is something magical about the view of the illuminated Ortaköy Mosque and Bosphorus Bridge, especially when you have a delicious cocktail in hand. This restaurant strikes a fine balance between chic and relaxed, and the service is attentive. The chefs, who can be seen at work in the open kitchen, let the ingredients speak for themselves. Their dishes are not overly elaborate, but rather classic fare with subtle zesty and spicy nuances. They give aubergine purée a delightful tang by mixing in yoghurt, making it an excellent accompaniment to barbecued lamb.

rows.name: Fauna
rows.address: Küçükbakkalköy Mahallesi, Işıklar Caddesi, Ahmet Muhip Dranas Sokak No:9/A, Ataşehir, Istanbul, 34750, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Lunch at Fauna is the perfect excuse to visit the Ataşehir district, just outside the city centre. Diners sit at long tables, often side by side with others, while the chefs get to work making fresh pasta. At Fauna, Italian and Turkish cuisine come together in generous shareable dishes. Think ravioli with a bold Obruk cheese filling cooked al dente and accompanied by a light butter sauce with a subtle tartness and sage. Local ingredients take centre stage in this ongoing pursuit of culinary finesse. Advance booking is strongly recommended!

rows.name: Tuti
rows.address: Yokuşbaşı Mahallesi, Suluhasan Caddesi No:18, Bodrum, 48400, Türkiye
rows.description_en: The castle and rooftops of Bodrum, the azure sea, even some Greek islands – the view from the top floor of The Marmara hotel is truly breathtaking! The restaurant has a Mediterranean feel, and that spirit carries through to the menu. The chef takes pride in skilfully elevating local ingredients and traditional recipes, for example, house-made pasta cooked al dente, tossed in a robust herb cream and topped with grated goat's cheese from the region, basil leaves and dried fruit. Be sure to treat yourself to the legendary baklava, too!

rows.name: Hakkasan Bodrum
rows.address: Göltürkbükü Mahallesi 314. Sokak No:12/1, Bodrum, 48400, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Located in the Mandarin Oriental hotel, against the wonderful backdrop of the glistening Aegean Sea, and with an elegant dining space with wood finishes, this floating open-air restaurant is stunning. Hakkasan, a renowned chain, brings a luxurious take on Cantonese cuisine to your table. Think wonderfully chewy lobster dim sum set enticingly on the plate, or a beautiful fillet of sea bass, grilled skin-on and glazed with honey for a pronounced umami note, complemented by hoisin sauce. Be sure to sample the signature cocktails; oenophiles will want to peruse the exclusive wine list. For a chic night out, Hakkasan is just the place – so don't forget to reserve a table in advance!

rows.name: Terakki
rows.address: Alaçatı, 12000. Sokak No:21, Çeşme, Izmir, 35930, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Rustic yet refined, warm and welcoming – Terakki is a gem. Nab a table on the terrace by the well and observe how the chefs skilfully balance authenticity and modern influences in their own take on generous Aegean cuisine. Think crispy fried veal liver seasoned with thyme, garlic and parsley, or succulent wild sea bass fillet with cherries for a hint of fruity vivacity and accompanied by a velvety cauliflower purée. The exceptional ingredients speak for themselves, requiring no embellishment. The hospitality of the service team comes as a delightful bonus.

rows.name: Sıralı Kebap
rows.address: Nispetiye Caddesi No:74, Beşiktaş, Istanbul, 34340, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Located in the heart of Beşiktaş, Sirali makes quite an impression. With its high ceilings, large windows and spacious kitchen, this restaurant is lively but still feels elegant – ideal for an intimate dinner or for larger parties wanting to sample a range of traditional Turkish food. The menu includes lahmacun with beef and lamb, fresh from the wood-fired oven, as well as succulent kebabs accompanied by a subtly tangy salad of tomatoes and olives. Whatever you choose, the chefs add thoughtful finishing touches and handle the fire with real skill. With such a striking array of dishes, you may not know where to start!

rows.name: Maromi İstanbul
rows.address: Asker Ocağı Caddesi No:1, Beyoğlu, Istanbul, 34367, Türkiye
rows.description_en: In Maromi, the Divan hotel boasts an excellent sushi restaurant, where you can dine at a regular table or sit at the counter – we highly recommend the latter to watch the chef in action. See how he tucks tender octopus and pickled daikon into a cradle of warm rice, or how he rolls salmon, spring onion and a fiery chilli pepper sauce in a mantle of toasted sesame seeds. Choose your sushi à la carte, or opt for the omakase menu and let the chef decide. On Tuesdays there's even an all-you-can-eat option!

rows.name: The BARN
rows.address: Gazitepe Mahallesi, Akören Cadddesi, Ören Çiftliği, No:114, Silivri, Istanbul, 34570, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Leave central Istanbul behind and head to Grandma's Wonderland in the Silivri district. This establishment set in verdant surroundings has both a hotel and this cosy restaurant, as well as a farm that supplies poultry, vegetables and other ingredients. Local produce is treated with great respect and, specialising in plant-forward cooking, the kitchen team adopts a zero-waste approach. The menu features skewers, veal tongue pastrami with cherry sauce, kasseri cheese tortellini, spinach and a butter sauce with white wine and sage. The farm-to-table concept is taken seriously here. A spot on the terrace, in the company of the resident dogs, and with a glass of wine from the estate in hand, is a must!

rows.name: Seten
rows.address: Aydınlı Mahallesi, Çakmaklı Sokak No:35, Göreme, Nevşehir, 50180, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Make your way from the centre of Göreme, past the charming boutiques, to the grounds of Sultan Cave Suites, home to the town's highest-altitude restaurant. The approach has a touch of magic to it – a feeling confirmed the moment you take in the magnificent view from the terrace. This is the perfect spot for watching the sunset! The menu reveals a clear devotion to traditional Anatolian cuisine: yoghurt with candied and fresh fruit or generously stuffed dolmas to start, followed by Cappadocian ravioli stuffed with minced lamb, accompanied by gently simmered chickpeas and yoghurt flavoured with dried herbs. Fruit and vegetables often come from their own garden, and even wine is made on site. Be sure to arrive early as they do not take reservations.

rows.name: Nahita Cappadocia
rows.address: Tekelli Mahallesi, Kayabaş Sokak No:23, Uçhisar, Nevşehir, 50240, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Nahita immediately impresses with one of its finest assets: you enter via the magnificent terrace, which affords romantic views over the valley. Inside, the stone walls are adorned with elegant details. The kitchen team sources ingredients from within a 60km radius to ensure the utmost authenticity in their local cuisine. Think warm dolmas with rice infused with the aroma of the vine leaves and sweet-and-sour cherries, finished with a few cherries and dill – pure pleasure on a plate. The chefs pack bold flavours into every dish, such as the distinctive herbs accompanying pan-fried liver. Set within the Argos hotel complex, this is a dining experience not to be missed.

rows.name: Terrazza Italia
rows.address: Levazım, Zorlu Center, Koru Sokak No:2, Beşiktaş, Istanbul, 34340, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Eataly is a world-renowned concept that celebrates the finest Italian foods. It always includes a large speciality market alongside superb dining options, such as this chic restaurant with its expansive terrace overlooking the cityscape. It should come as no surprise that authentic Italian cuisine takes centre stage. Think vitello tonnato with its delicate harmony of veal and tuna, al dente tagliatelle with pistachio pesto and red prawn tartare, or a creative take on tiramisu – the chefs pay tribute to traditional flavours while introducing a touch of flair. The extensive menu will definitely leave you spoilt for choice!

rows.name: Balıkçı Kahraman
rows.address: Rumeli Kavağı Mahallesi, İskele Caddesi No:15/1, Sarıyer, Istanbul, 34450, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Be sure to try the fish kokoreç, a traditional dish made with grilled fish offal; the perfectly grilled turbot, which is the house speciality, is also a must; and let's not forget the dried mackerel, nor the buttery-soft tuna lakerda prepared with house-made olive oil. A word to the wise: The best way to experience Kahraman Altun's cosy fish restaurant is to bring friends and sample as many of his traditionally prepared delicacies as possible. Afterwards, you should definitely take the time to explore the surrounding fishing village of Rumeli Kavağı (also known for its figs). This peaceful corner of Istanbul is sure to enchant you.

rows.name: Park Fora Balık ve Deniz Ürünleri Restoranı
rows.address: Muallim Naci Caddesi No:54/A, Cemil Topuzlu Parkı İçi, Kuruçeşme/Beşiktaş, Istanbul, 34347, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Grilled, meunière, steamed, tandoori – however you like your fish, Park Fora has it covered. At this traditional seafood restaurant, the produce is always in season and super fresh. As you enter, you will see crates of the day's catch stacked and waiting and numerous aquariums filled with king crabs, lobsters and other creatures. Specify your cooking preferences – for us, it was sole à la meunière – and then savour! It will be cooked to perfection and accompanied by carefully prepared accoutrements. Factor in the waterfront location, with views of the boats coming and going on the Bosphorus, and you will really feel like you are on holiday!

rows.address: Ulus Mahallesi, Ahmet Adnan Saygun Caddesi, Ulus Parkı İçi No:71/1, Beşiktaş, Istanbul, 34340, Türkiye
rows.description_en: As soon as you enter, you realise how exceptional this upscale restaurant is. The views of the bustling Bosphorus, the enchanting minarets and the Istanbul skyline are unparalleled! To really make the most of your fine dining experience at the elegant 29, book a table on the expansive terrace. The generosity and spiciness of traditional Turkish cuisine are given a subtle modern twist, often incorporating Mediterranean touches. Both the authentic mezze and the smooth mushroom risotto make this place the trip. Featuring an impressive selection of top-flight labels, the extensive wine menu is worthy of attention.

rows.name: Kıyı Restaurant
rows.address: Haydar Aliyev Caddesi No:186/A, Tarabya/Sarıyer, Istanbul, 34457, Türkiye
rows.description_en: If you're looking for an atmospheric seafood restaurant adorned with beautiful paintings and affording breathtaking views of the picturesque marina, then this perennial favourite is the place for you (ask for a table upstairs)! Start with a selection of mezze and then choose from the bountiful array of fish and seafood, which will be prepared according to your desires. Our inspector opted for sole from the display fridge, which was flawlessly pan-fried before being filleted at the table. It's all about the produce here!

rows.name: BİZ İstanbul
rows.address: Atatürk Kültür Merkezi, Gümüşsuyu Mahallesi, Mete Caddesi No:2, Beyoğlu, Istanbul, 34337, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Head to the world-famous Taksim Square and take the lift to this spacious restaurant on the seventh floor of the Atatürk Cultural Centre. The interior is elegant and modern, complete with a stylish bar, but nothing compares to the terrace and its stunning views of the city and the Bosphorus. The menu celebrates the diversity of Turkish cuisine through contemporary interpretations of traditional dishes. For instance, a combination of subtly smoky aubergine purée, braised lamb, walnuts and a creamy lamb jus makes for a deeply layered main course. The chefs have an eye for detail, but it is the rich flavours that truly steal the show.

rows.name: Avlu Restaurant
rows.address: Cankurtaran, Tevkifhane Sokak No:1, Fatih, Istanbul, 34122, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Once a prison, the Four Seasons Hotel Sultanahmet now exudes luxury down to every last detail. Nestled in the inner courtyard, Avlu has a casual feel, a Mediterranean oasis in which you can escape the bustle of the city. Your meal starts with some delicious bread from the wood-fired oven and continues with this fresh take on indulgent Turkish fare. The chef prepares turbot both pan-fried to a succulent finish and folded into dumplings with cauliflower and spinach, rounding off the dish with the fine contrast of a rich sauce and a fresh salad. Between the wide-ranging à la carte selection of Anatolian classics and the tempting set menu (also available in a vegetarian version), making up your mind is the hardest part.

rows.name: Khorasani
rows.address: Alemdar Mahallesi, Ticarethane Sokak No:9/B, Fatih, Istanbul, 34110, Türkiye
rows.description_en: The Sultanahmet neighbourhood is known for all its tourist restaurants, where menus consist of photographs of dishes. In that respect it's no different at the rustic-style Khorasani, but what sets this grill restaurant apart is the chef's dedication to quality. The meat, barbecued to order, and the kebabs are second to none. We thoroughly enjoyed the kebab with succulent lamb, crisp vegetables and, of course, the wonderful pita bread that comes with it. For flavoursome food with no nonsense, Khorasani is the place.

rows.name: Seki Restaurant
rows.address: Tekelli, Kayabaş Sokak No:23, Uçhisar, Nevşehir, 50240, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Seki is located on the ground floor of luxury hotel Argos, which was once a monastery built into a hillside that makes for a truly magnificent setting. Be sure to allow time for a stroll along the paths leading through the garden. Inside, you can have an aperitif in the romantic lounge and take in the breathtaking view of the valley, then move into the restaurant itself, which has that distinctively welcoming Cappadocian feel. In these splendid surroundings, diners tuck into local Anatolian dishes with a Mediterranean twist. For example, the chefs balance the sweetness of confit pumpkin with a light tahini paste, sesame seeds and chopped walnuts. The extensive menu encompasses classics such as mezze, salads and lamb specialities, as well as pasta and vegan options. Featuring some 300 labels, the wine list is certainly worth exploring.

rows.name: Karnas Vineyards
rows.address: Çömlekçi, Sokak No:400, Bodrum, 48400, Türkiye
rows.description_en: As soon as you drive onto this family-owned wine estate, you sense that something special is about to happen. The large pond with its fountain draws the eyes, and the terrace overlooking the vines has a delightful Mediterranean feel – it's the stuff of dreams! The allure of this place leaves no one indifferent. Don't miss the chance to sample the estate's wines – the perfect introduction to Bodrum's terroir. The chef operates on a farm-to-fork principle and is also committed to sourcing local produce wherever possible. She sets great store by her ingredients, which often come from her own garden. For example, she perfectly pan-fries ultra-fresh sea bass and combines it with braised seaweed, mandarin marmalade, a butter oil emulsion and lime zest – this is a chef who brings a unique and nuanced perspective to traditional dishes.

rows.name: Lokanta Limu
rows.address: Yeniköy, Köybaşı Caddesi No:158 D:B, Sarıyer, Istanbul, 34464, Türkiye
rows.description_en: With its bright interior and appealing artworks, Lokanta Limu stands out even in this bustling neighbourhood. The decor radiates a sense of serenity, and the closely spaced tables create a convivial atmosphere. Sara Tabrizi and her team of chefs delight in creating generous mezze spreads that bring a fresh perspective to authentic Turkish flavours. Think tuna marinated in raki and served with parsley, apple and red onion, or briefly seared lamb's liver with fried potatoes and onion. The extensive menu features plenty of enticing options that lend themselves well to sharing. To explore a wide range of dishes without breaking the bank, choose the Çilingir Sofrası set menu.

rows.name: Scappi
rows.address: Alsancak, Gaziosmanpaşa Bulvarı No:1, Konak, Izmir, 35210, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Take the lift to the ninth floor of Swissôtel and immerse yourself in the elegant setting of Scappi. It's definitely worth trying to secure a spot on the terrace, where you get to take in the views of the bay and the sea – the sunsets are simply divine! But perhaps you would prefer to home in on the action in the partially open kitchen complete with pizza oven. With great skill, the chefs rustle up dishes such as a creamy risotto with barbecued squid, al dente house-made pasta with an aromatic tomato sauce, or freshly caught sea bass with a saffron-infused lime sauce. This is a popular place, so don't forget to make a reservation.

rows.name: St. Regis Brasserie
rows.address: Mim Kemal Öke Caddesi No:35, Nişantaşı/Şişli, Istanbul, 34367, Türkiye
rows.description_en: This chic, urban-style luxury brasserie at the St Regis Hotel would not seem out of place in Paris. Begin with a cocktail – the house take on the Bloody Mary, made with raki, is a must. The extensive à la carte menu truly offers something for everyone, from Asian dishes (eg gyoza) and Turkish mezze to Italian pasta and risotto – the choice is yours! The kebab with succulent meatballs, grilled peppers, a silky butter sauce with just the right level of heat and a thick yoghurt paste is rightly a house signature. Dishes are down-to-earth and generous, bringing together flavours from around the globe – always balanced and lovingly prepared.

rows.name: Giritli
rows.address: Yenigüvey Sokak No:9, Cankurtaran/Fatih, Istanbul, 34122, Türkiye
rows.description_en: In summer, Giritli welcomes you to its atmospheric terrace, where the kitchen is also located. If the weather lets you down, you can always cross the street to the romantic Mediterranean-style sister restaurant. Be sure to explore the enticing mezze set menu (drinks included), which inventively showcases the traditional flavours of Crete. The perfectly seasoned and generously portioned dishes feature impeccably fresh produce. Think marinated sea bass with fresh herbs, or potato salad with a judicious touch of vinegar and vibrant tzatziki. A real feast!

rows.name: Aheste
rows.address: Asmalı Mescit Mahallesi, Meşrutiyet Caddesi No:107/F, Beyoğlu, Istanbul, 34430, Türkiye
rows.description_en: Once you enter the premises, leaving the bustling Pera district behind, you have a choice between a trendy bistro and a more romantic dining space with a vaulted ceiling. In either case, you'll be charmed by the mystical ambiance and the staff's enthusiasm and dedication – and that's before you've even discovered the restaurant's modern take on mezze! Traditional Turkish specialities, such as barbecued lamb heart with roast potatoes, share the menu with in-vogue options, including vegetarian dishes. The tasting menu offers a wonderful opportunity to savour delicacies such as flaky pastry filled with a creamy tuna tarama.

rows.name: Kurul Bitez
rows.address: Bitez Mahallesi, 1936. Sokak No:2, Bodrum, 48470, Türkiye
rows.description_en: In the heart of the bustling centre of Bitez, there is a large garden where you can unwind amid olive and lemon trees while enjoying delicious food. Welcome to Kurul Bitez, where kebabs are the speciality of the house. You can see this for yourself at the entrance, where the spit is always turning and the bread oven is working at full tilt. Chef Kemal Karataş gives Gaziantep cuisine a contemporary twist, as in the crisp pistachio roll filled with creamy sheep's cheese, generously topped with pistachios and a nut cream, and accompanied by a quenelle of sour cream. Be sure to try his aromatic mezze, too – they are simply too good to be missed!

rows.name: Kısmet Lokantası
rows.address: Çırkan Mahallesi, Çelebi Kaptan Sokak No:3/A, Konacık, Bodrum, 48400, Türkiye
rows.description_en: If you're on the hunt for a lively place in which to have lunch among the locals, look no further. Kismet Lokantasi serves delicious food at great value for money in a laid-back atmosphere. Peruse the counter for traditional delicacies prepared by the chef, then choose your favourites. Think succulent meatballs with grilled aubergine and tomato sauce, and, for dessert, a rich patisserie with walnuts and just the right amount of sweet syrup – foodies will be in seventh heaven! This indulgent dining experience will leave a lasting impression.

rows.name: ROKA
rows.address: Kılıçalipaşa Mahallesi, Meclis-i Mebusan Sokak No:14/2E, Beyoğlu, Istanbul, 34433, Türkiye
rows.description_en: ROKA boasts stunning Bosphorus views, thanks to its location on the Galataport promenade. Inside, the atmosphere is trendy and vibrant. Kick off with a stylish cocktail or an expertly selected wine, then prepare to experience a cuisine that marries Japanese seasonings with influences from around the globe. Fans of Asian cuisine can choose from an abundant menu of dishes that are perfect for sharing, including an extensive sushi selection, king crab dumplings, succulent chicken and yuzu miso-marinated cod from the robatayaki grill.
